attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is Size 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Universal Weapon
steps: |!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is Size 4 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.
After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Kree Justice
steps: After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| and |§stagger§Stagger| special conditions.
|!wild| |*Explosive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Judgment
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 3 of this character is damaged by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, you may use this superpower. The character that caused the effect gains the |§judgment§Judgment| special condition.

superPowers.name: The Accuser
superPowers.body: If an enemy effect would cause this character to be Dazed or KO'd, it may use this superpower. It is not Dazed or KO'd. After the effect is resolved, this character Advances |!range_small|, makes one attack targeting the enemy character that caused the effect, and is then Dazed or KO'd.
